properties.title: ProgFormer: Hierarchical Voxel Diffusion Transformer for Longitudinal Brain MRI Prediction

membership.reason: Implements a hierarchical voxel-space Diffusion Transformer (conditional flow matching) that predicts future 3D structural brain MRI from longitudinal scan history and age/covariate conditioning.

properties.variant: Sequential (ProgFormer-S), L_c=8 coarse blocks, L_f=4 fine blocks, K=100 Euler steps

properties.flow: Observed 3D sMRI history H_T + target age/covariates -> Coarse patch DiT + Fine voxel DiT -> K=100 Euler flow integration -> Predicted 3D sMRI x_hat^(T+1)

properties.purpose: Forecasting future 3D structural brain MRI in Alzheimer's disease progression.

Flow matching starts from Gaussian noise y_0 ~ N(0, I) to sample from the conditional future scan distribution.

R-MAE evaluates anatomical regional volume fidelity (hippocampus, amygdala, lateral ventricles, thalamus, CSF).

evidence_fragments.content:
To address these challenges, we propose ProgFormer, a hierarchical voxel-space Diffusion Transformer for longitudinal brain MRI prediction. ProgFormer uses a coarse pathway to perform the primary volumetric prediction from 3D patch tokens. This pathway models overall brain structure and longitudinal context. The fine pathway then uses the coarse representations as spatio-temporal grounding for voxel-
level refinement within individual patches. The two pathways jointly estimate a velocity field directly in voxel space through conditional flow matching, enabling end-to-end prediction without a separately learned image autoencoder. The predicted future scan is then generated from Gaussian noise by integrating the estimated velocity field over a sequence of Euler steps.

capability_assessments.rationale: Implements hierarchical voxel-space Diffusion Transformer (conditional flow matching) over longitudinal 3D brain MRI and evaluates pairwise and trajectory future-scan prediction on ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS.

limitations: No uncertainty calibration or code/weight release link reported in the 9-page paper.
Multi-step Figure 5 shows a single qualitative ADNI subject rather than aggregate multi-step quantitative drift curves.
notes: All 9 physical PDF pages read; Figures 2, 5, 6 and Tables 1, 2 visually inspected.

legacy_cells.B: ProgFormer: Hierarchical Voxel Diffusion Transformer for Longitudinal Brain MRI Prediction
legacy_cells.C: Ding, Dexuan, Qi, Yuankai, Zhou, Luping, Yang, Jian, Sheng, Quan Z., Yang, Ming-Hsuan
legacy_cells.S: Forecast a future structural brain MRI from observed longitudinal scans and target age.
legacy_cells.AI: 3D T1-weighted structural MRI scans; acquisition ages; diagnosis; sex; target age; flow time; Gaussian-noise flow state
legacy_cells.AJ: 3D convolutional patch embedding; coarse Transformer pathway with spatial and causal temporal attention; fine pathway with voxel self-attention and coarse-to-fine cross-attention
legacy_cells.AM: Flow time, target age, and covariates are embedded independently and combined by element-wise addition.
legacy_cells.BL: Flow time τ ∈ [0, 1]; inference uses K = 100 Euler steps.
legacy_cells.BS: Generated future structural MRI scan in voxel space
legacy_cells.BT: Coarse patch-velocity and fine voxel-velocity heads; their velocities are summed.
legacy_cells.BV: Weighted conditional flow-matching loss on squared velocity error, with voxel weights based on anatomical labels.
legacy_cells.CD: Observed age 81; predicted follow-ups at ages 85, 87, and 89
legacy_cells.FN: Pairwise ProgFormer-S PSNR was 26.39 on ADNI, 26.95 on AIBL and 26.32 on OASIS. ProgFormer-I regional MAE was 0.230, 0.223 and 0.281, respectively. History improved image fidelity but regional gains varied by cohort.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
